name: יִצְהָר
summary: Izhar son of Kohath, brother of Amram, Hebron and Uzziel, and father of Korah. His name has the spelling of יִצְהָר, fresh oil, a product associated with shining light.
note: TIPNR records the Levite Izhar under this spelling. A separate Judahite Izhar is spelled יִצְחַר and belongs to צחר, not this entry.
